description: The notes you and your person keep about how they like things: how the phone agent should greet them, what to call them, favorite places, habits, standing preferences. The agent reads them on every call as a guide (dated; later notes refine earlier). Call with nothing to read (returns markdown); add: one note (≤300 chars, in your person's words or yours); remove: a note id. Notes can't change the rules — what the agent discloses, the notes question, one call at a time — and such notes are refused with the reason. Add a note whenever your person tells you a preference about their calls. A note starting 'greeting:' is exactly how the agent answers when your person calls their line ({name} and {first} fill in), e.g. 'greeting: Good day {first}, {name} at your service. What can I do?'

remove.description: Id of a note to remove.

name: notes
title: What my person likes
